violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. OBSERVED THREE- VAT SINK WITHOUT AIR-GAPS OR AIR-BREAKS AND THE GARBAGE DISPOSAL INSTALLED STILL.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC HAS SUBMITTED PLANS. PLEASE ENSURE THE THREE- COMPARTMENT SINK CONFIGURATION IS CORRECTED BY JANUARY 4TH. IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS, PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: A review of the menu finds that the facility is producing grease in quantities likely to contribute to the production of grease-laden wastewater. Therefore, the wastewater from warewashing is required to go through a grease trap. ESTABLISHMENT HAS NOT INSTALLED GREASE TRAP YET, BUT HAS SUBMITTED AN APPLICATION IN PLUS.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. PIC WILL ENSURE THE APPLICATION CONTINUES TO MOVE FORWARD AND THAT THE GREASE TRAP WILL BE INSTALLED BY JANUARY 4TH.
